Comments.AF and Anthracycline: AF may be a secondary result of anthracycline cardiotoxicity.
Comments.Stem Cell Transplantation: Associated with increased risk of AF.
Comments.BTK Inhibitors: Ibrutinib reported varying rates of AF; second-generation BTK inhibitors have lower incidence.
Comments.FDA Adverse Event Reporting: TKIs have associated AF based on FDA adverse events.

General Information.Increased Risk of AF: Cancer therapies can increase the risk of AF in patients, particularly those with hypertension, MI, HF, or history of cancer.
General Information.Impact of GDMT: GDMT may reduce AF recurrence and major adverse cardiovascular events.
General Information.DOACs vs Warfarin: Lower risk of stroke/systemic embolism and major bleeding with DOACs in patients with AF and cancer.
